newsitem.title: USA: PanEnergy chairman Hendrix to step down.
newsitem.headline: PanEnergy chairman Hendrix to step down.

text.p: PanEnergy Corp on Thursday said Dennis Hendrix decided to step down as chairman of the board effective at the annual shareholders meeting on April 24.
The company said in a statement that he would be succeeded by Chief Executive and President Paul Anderson, 51.

When Anderson became chief executive officer in 1995, he and Hendrix, 57, agreed that Hendrix would step down after his contract ended in November 1996, a company spokesman said. Anderson then would succeed him.
Anderson will serve as chairman, president and chief executive until PanEnergy's merger with Duke Power Co is completed.
After the merger, the company will change its name to Duke Energy Corp. Anderson will then become president and chief operating officer of Duke Energy.
Hendrix will continue to serve on the PanEnergy board until the merger. He then will be on the Duke Energy board.
